newsitem.title: EGYPT: Phillips to make polyethylene in Egypt - minister.
newsitem.headline: Phillips to make polyethylene in Egypt - minister.

text.p: Egyptian Oil Minister Hamdi el-Banbi said on Wednesday U.S. company Phillips Petroleum Co would build a plant in Egypt with an annual output of 150,000 tonnes of high density polyethylene.

"This is the first petrochemical project in Egypt with international private investors. It will be built in the Egyptian petrochemical complex in Alexandria," Banbi told a session of the Middle East and North Africa Economic Conference.

The state's Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation and Phillips 66 would construct the plant, he added. Banbi did not say how much the project would cost and Phillips officials were not immediately available for comment.
